name: county-assistant
description: Your general government operations assistant for policy guidance, department directory, and citizen services information
usageGuidelines: Use this assistant for general county government questions, policy guidance, and department information. For specialized topics (property assessment, legal, etc.), use the specialized GPTs.
limitations: Cannot access confidential records. Cannot provide legal advice. Cannot make policy decisions.
examplePrompts: What are the office hours for the County Clerk?
How do I request public records?
What is the county's policy on remote work?
Who should I contact about a zoning question?
